summary: IDS feed s059_single is degraded due to tool overload: 1.61 Gbps microbursts exceed the 1 Gbps IDS port capacity (161% utilization, 6 intervals). All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Aggregated/bursty traffic peaks at 1.61 Gbps in 1ms intervals exceed the IDS 1 Gbps port capacity (161% of line rate, 6 overloaded intervals). Single 1G tool port is undersized for microbursts with no load balancing.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS will drop packets during bursts, causing missed signatures, incomplete TCP reassembly and flow state, and blind spots for both directions despite needing full payload and bidirectional visibility.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute microbursts across 2x1G ports or a 2G LAG / second IDS instance using 5-tuple hashing to keep flows intact and keep peak utilization below 80% threshold, preventing burst drops without filtering needed traffic.
